pages.text: A network of V junctions needs at least V − 1 links to join them all (a tree). Each link beyond that closes a loop: a spare route. With L − V + 1 spares there are L − V + 2 independent routes, and the network is cut only if every one of them fails. Each link fails with a chance q, so it fails about q^(L − V + 2) of the time.

$(thing)Limits$(): Too few links to join every junction.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): Fewer links per junction are faster.
